title: For Loop

lines.explanation:
The for statement provides a compact way to iterate over a range of values. There are three things included inside the parentheses, initialization, 
termination and increment/decrement. The initialization 
expression initializes the loop; it's executed once, as the loop begins. 
When the termination expression evaluates to false, the loop terminates. 
The increment expression is invoked after each iteration through the loop. 
Here, an integer i is initialized to 1. After each iteration, i increases 1. 
Once i reaches 11, the termination expression becomes false. The loop 
terminates.

Inside the for loop, each iteration will print a line which consists the string literal "Count is: " and the value of i. The print out will be 10 lines, the first 
is "Count is: 1", the second line is "Count is: 2", and so forth until the the last line that which is "Count is: 10"
